markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (96%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second-model agreement, no input flag. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 96%, Invasive 4% | Clear separation |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.998 / 90th pct | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 InSitu | Moderate support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 2) · ↓ invasive · Slightly below-typical score; small pull away from invasive · Validated [F4]
- **Nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Score far below typical; linked to lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Atypical cells within ducts** (regions 4, 10) · ↓ invasive · High score, fits duct-confined disease · Weak
- **Normal lobules** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Largest term, but spot check 0/20 · Unreliable [F2]

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 region removal drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60): faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) is Unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- Region 2 or 9 holds stromal invasion; regional invasive risks are 92% and 75%.
- Simulated stain degradation (severity 3) may have shifted features; reliability only moderately flags errors (AUROC 0.69).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 2** — look for stromal invasion; highest regional invasive risk (92%).
2. **Region 9** — check for invasive foci; regional invasive risk 75%.
3. **Regions 4, 10** — confirm atypical cells stay inside duct walls.
